info.title: jeeves-watcher
info.description: HTTP API of the jeeves-watcher service: the routes in its endpoint catalog (WATCHER_CATALOG). Every route except GET /status requires the API key as a bearer token when api.apiKey is configured.

get.description: Get watcher service health, version, and uptime.

additionalProperties.description: System payload index state: building (background creation running), ready, conflict (the field has another index type; left alone) or failed (creation failed; retried at the next start).

systemIndexes.description: System payload indexes the service creates whatever payloadIndexes says (chunk_index integer, file_path and matched_rules keyword), by field.

state.description: ok, or failing: at least 3 embedding failures since the last success and 60 s without one. The first success returns it to ok.

lastSuccessAt.description: Last successful embedding call (ISO), null before the first.

code.description: rate_limited, timeout, http_<status>, network or error (no provider text).

lastError.description: Most recent embedding error, null if none yet.

failingSince.description: When the state turned failing (ISO), null while ok.

backoffUntil.description: End of the stored provider back-off (ISO, at most 5 minutes ahead), null if none.

resubscribes.description: Subscriptions re-created after an error since start (D131); scheduled renewals are not counted. Always 0 under chokidar.

reconcileEvents.description: Synthetic events reconciliation has emitted since start (D90): a rising value means the source is missing events.

reconcileErrors.description: Reconciles that errored (walk failure, unreachable root, empty root walk against a non-empty inventory) and emitted nothing, since start (D90).

lastReconcileAt.description: End of the most recent reconcile (ISO), null before the first.

lastReconcileDurationMs.description: Duration of the most recent reconcile, walk and compare (ms), null before the first.

pendingStability.description: Paths in the stability ticker's pending set (D128); a backlog that keeps growing means the ticker is falling behind.

lastRenewDurationMs.description: Duration of the most recent subscription renewal (ms, D129); null until the first, and always null under chokidar and on Windows.

renewFailures.description: Renewals whose unsubscribe rejected and forced a source rebuild, plus rejections during a rebuild, since start (D165, D176). Always 0 under chokidar.

get.description: List available search facets and their values: every field a rule schema gives a uiHint or enum, with its declared or recorded values. With `rules`, only the fields and values of those rules.

parameters.name: rules

schema.description: Comma-separated rule names (configured or registered at runtime): only fields those rules declare, with values recorded for their documents. Unknown names answer 400. Without it, every configured rule.

parameters.description: Comma-separated rule names (configured or registered at runtime): only fields those rules declare, with values recorded for their documents. Unknown names answer 400. Without it, every configured rule.

post.description: Count the values of payload fields over the documents matching a filter (each document once, not each chunk), or give { min, max } for a numeric or date field. Counts are approximate (Qdrant facet estimates); ranges are exact. `rules` keeps only documents of those rules. Each field needs a payload index (else 400). Fields are counted 4 at a time within a 10 s budget; past it the route answers 503 `not_available` naming the fields not counted. It also answers 503 until the `chunk_index` system index is ready, and with `rules` until `matched_rules` is.

filter.description: Qdrant filter scoping the counts, as for search (e.g. a tenant condition).

rules.description: Rule names (configured or registered at runtime): only documents that matched at least one of them are counted, each once. Unknown names answer 400.

fields.description: Payload fields to count (1 to 20). Each needs a payload index: keyword, integer or bool for value counts; integer, float or datetime for a range.

limit.description: Most values per counted field, highest counts first (default 100, max 1000).

counts.description: Per requested field: value counts (documents, highest first), or { min, max } for a numeric or date field.

post.description: Set or update metadata on a document by file path or source reference. While the document is being processed the route waits at most 10 s for its lock, then answers 503 `not_available` with `Retry-After: 10`, nothing changed (retry).
Trigger a scoped reindex of watched files (scope path also accepts source references).

scope.description: Reindex scope: "issues" re-processes documents that failed; "rules" re-applies inference rules without re-embedding; "full" re-embeds everything; "path" reindexes the given files or directories (`path`) or source references (`source`); "prune" deletes points for files no longer in watch scope.

dryRun.description: Return the blast-area plan (counts by root) without running the reindex.

post.description: Re-apply inference rules to existing vector points. The route waits at most 10 s for each document lock; if one stays busy it answers 503 `not_available` with `Retry-After: 10`, and documents already updated keep their update (retry to finish).
Rebuild the enrichment store from vector point payloads (file points only).

Delete source documents by reference or by Qdrant filter (at least one condition; constrained to points carrying source and no file_path). The route waits at most 10 s for each document lock; if one stays busy it answers 503 `not_available` with `Retry-After: 10`, and documents already deleted stay deleted (retry to finish).
Delete points from the vector store by filter.

delete.description: Unregister all external inference rules from a source.

post.description: Restore files from a historical commit (forward-only reversion). Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

existingOnly.description: Restore only files that exist in the working tree.

post.description: Exclude a path from version history (VCS-only: it stays in search) or remove the exclusion. The glob is a gitignore pattern, so brackets are a character class: escape them to name a file literally (`Report \[draft\].docx`). Adding a pattern also untracks the tracked files it matches, in one commit (history stops for them; the files stay on disk and in search); `remove` does not restore that history. More than 100 files to untrack need `confirm: true` (else 409 `confirm_required` with `untracked`, nothing written). The route waits at most 30 s for the root's git lock, then answers 503 `not_available` with `Retry-After: 30`, nothing written. A glob outside an explicit `root` is 400; a glob under no VCS root is 404. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

glob.description: One gitignore pattern, absolute (under a VCS root) or relative to `root`. It is written root-anchored (`/` + the root-relative pattern) to the root's `.git/info/exclude`. Brackets are a character class: escape them to name a file literally (`Report \[draft\].docx`). A newline, a leading `!` or `#`, braces, or a pattern matching the whole root is refused.

remove.description: Remove the pattern instead of adding it (from `.git/info/exclude`, else from the `.gitignore` a 0.20.0 exclude wrote). Files are not re-added; their next change is versioned again.

root.description: VCS root to write under (default: the root containing the glob); a glob outside it is refused.

confirm.description: Required (true) when adding the pattern would untrack more than 100 files.
